result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now exists as a second name for `updateLandscape`. The `cli` module compiles. I didn't run the command or any tests, so `-help` and the landscape output are untested.

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` with a description saying it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview and uses the same options as `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: the existing `updateLandscape` branch now also matches `analyzeLandscape`, so both run the same code with the same options. `-help` prints the usage of whichever name was typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape command" section for `analyzeLandscape` that mentions `updateLandscape` is kept.

I left `CLAUDE.md` alone, so its list of main commands doesn't include `analyzeLandscape` yet.
